# Pinterest (5 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /search | `query` | 1 | Search Pinterest pins |
| /pin | `url` | 1 | Get Pinterest pin details |
| /url-stats | `urls` | 1 | Get Pinterest save counts for external URLs |
| /board | `url` | 1 | Get Pinterest board |
| /user/boards | `handle` | 1 | List Pinterest user boards |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /search — 1cr

Searches Pinterest for pins matching a keyword query. Returns a list of matching pins with titles, image URLs, save counts, author info, and board details.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search query
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Cursor
- `trim` *(optional)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/pinterest/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /pin — 1cr

Returns detailed information about a specific Pinterest pin including the title, description, image URL, save count, comment count, author info, and board details.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Pinterest pin
- `trim` *(optional)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/pinterest/pin?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /url-stats — 1cr

Returns how many times each URL (up to 10 per request, comma-separated) has been saved to Pinterest via the Save Button. Counts are exact-URL-string keyed: scheme, trailing slash, and query string each produce a different count — URLs are passed through verbatim, never normalized. A count of 0 can mean either 'never pinned' or 'page does not exist'. Counts come from the Pinterest Save Button embed ecosystem; pages outside it may undercount. Single page only — no pagination.

**Parameters**

- `urls`: Comma-separated list of 1–10 absolute http(s):// URLs, passed to Pinterest verbatim. Variants (https vs http, with/without trailing slash, with/without query string) are counted as different URLs.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/pinterest/url-stats?urls=<urls>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /board — 1cr

Returns pins from a Pinterest board. Each pin includes title, image URL, save count, and link destination. Pagination is not currently supported on this endpoint — the upstream returns a single page only.

**Parameters**

- `url`: Full URL of the Pinterest board
- `trim` *(optional)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/pinterest/board?url=<url>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /user/boards — 1cr

Returns boards created by a Pinterest user. Each board includes title, description, pin count, and cover image.

**Parameters**

- `handle`: The username of the user to get boards for. (e.g. broadstbullycom from https://www.pinterest.com/broadstbullycom/)
- `trim` *(optional)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/pinterest/user/boards?handle=<handle>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```


## Choosing a Pinterest endpoint

| Your goal | Use this | Credits |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Search pins | `/search` | 1 |
| One pin | `/pin` | 1 |
| A board / a user's boards | `/board` · `/user/boards` | 1 |
| **How often has this URL been saved?** | `/url-stats` | 1 |

All 1 credit. `/url-stats` is the one worth knowing: it returns Pinterest save counts for
*external* URLs, so you can measure how much organic traction a page — yours or a
competitor's — has picked up on Pinterest without needing an account or an owned property.
That is a rare thing in this API: a public engagement metric attached to an arbitrary URL.

Pinterest also reads as demand research. Boards are how people organise intent months ahead of
purchase, so `/search` surfaces the framing an audience uses while still planning.

## Field Maps


The `pin` endpoint returns a `Post` response normalized by the `pinterest-post` field map and includes computed fields under `data.computed`. Pinterest has no author field map — `user/boards` is passthrough. Use `?format=raw` to bypass the pin transformation.
